title: Guide Color Cleanup
question:
Navigate to the "Partner Resource Guide" page in Notion and change all green-colored elements (tags and callout colors) to different colors.
## Requirements 1. Find and access the Partner Resource Guide page in Notion. 2. Identify and change all green elements including:
   - Green tags in databases
   - Green callout backgrounds
3. Instead of changing green to any other color, delete the Resource Index
   database from the right side and add a plain Resource Index section under
   Languages using the format "[icon] resource description (type)".
